analysis_type: Retrospective diagnostic reanalysis; no new confirmatory claims

power.mde_limit: The endpoint is probability of strictly exceeding a fixed floor. A log-variance minimum detectable mean requires an effect distribution assumption; effect magnitude above the floor does not change this test.
power.holm_limit: This is the strictest first step. Later claims can use less stringent cutoffs if earlier ordered claims reject. Dependence and nested claims do not invalidate Holm.
